name: Science Alliance High School Program
what_you_do: Take a hands-on science class at the Museum after school. Topics include anthropology, astrophysics, conservation science, Earth science, and evolution. Winter 2027 offers a genetics class.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12. Sign up for the class that matches your grade band.
pay_detail: Each fall, winter, or spring course costs $1,000. Half of the seats in each class are held for families who ask for free or reduced tuition, based on household income. These seats go first come, first served.
duration: Three sessions a year (fall, winter, spring). Classes meet Tuesdays and/or Thursdays, 4:30 to 6:30 p.m. Winter 2027 genetics: January 7 to March 4, Tuesdays and Thursdays.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 sales opened October 8, 2026. Winter 2027 genetics runs January 7 to March 4, 2027. The page does not say when winter sign up opens or closes.
how_to_apply: Buy a seat with the purchase button on the course listing, or call Central Reservations at 212-769-5200. For free or reduced tuition, do not pay online: fill out the Tuition Assistance application instead.
notes: Free tuition goes to a family of 4 with income of $124,240 or less (see the page for other sizes). Taking Science Alliance also counts toward the Museum's SCIP and SRMP rules. Questions: ScienceAlliance@amnh.org.
